challenge.geowords: app-generated from the review words of sections 1-5 (rules and spot-check sample to follow; approved like review puzzles)

prompt.object: the object name as on the map (name.en / name.ru in data/maps), shown under the prompt; no records or facts in Speed Hunt

speedHunt.order: random, no object repeats within a round
speedHunt.correct: +1 and the next object at once
speedHunt.wrong: the right place lights up for 0.5 s; no penalty except time; the object goes into the spaced-repetition queue
speedHunt.hit: a tap counts if it is inside the object tap area or within 22 CSS px of it and no other object in the pool is closer; when several are near, the nearest object wins

excluded.why: answered in magnifier insets; no time to open a magnifier in 60 s

speedHunt.score: objects found in the round + personal best
